about: Which render path each style class gets on each tier, and what of catalog/tiers.json render_paths is built. `runs`: the path's base pass exists, so a game of this style can run on the tier. `missing`: parts of the catalog's description that are not built yet (ids under `deferred`). The Rust table in crates/evani-render/src/render_path.rs must match this file (test `table_matches_assets_json`); `cargo xtask check` reads this file. Edit both when a part gets built. The `3d` path is compiled only when a crate of the game turns on evani-render's `forward` feature (the 3D kits do; 2D games leave it off and never download it; `cargo xtask check` flags a mismatch).

pseudo-3d-pass.who: first Phase B kit whose genre lists pseudo-3d-road or pseudo-3d-raycast
pseudo-3d-pass.what: pseudo-3D pass into a 320x180 to 640x360 target with nearest upscale

2d-normal-lighting.what: normal-mapped 2D lighting in a light buffer (High, Ultra)

cpu-frustum-culling.what: CPU frustum culling with instancing (Medium and up)

point-lights.what: up to 8 point lights in the forward pass

clustered-forward.what: clustered forward with compute light binning

gpu-driven-culling.what: compute frustum and occlusion culling with indirect draws (Ultra)

shadow-cascades-4.who: Ultra frame target with unlimited detail

volumetric-passes.who: Ultra frame target with unlimited detail

temporal-upscale.who: Ultra frame target with unlimited detail

vr-stereo.what: single-pass stereo render path with 4x MSAA and foveation
